# Vendored libraries

- `posthog.js`: posthog-js 1.444.4, `dist/array.full.no-external.js` (the bundle that never loads code from the network),
  from npm on 3 Nov 2026. Licence: Apache-2.0 and MIT (`POSTHOG-LICENSE`). Loaded only when the build carries a PostHog key
  (`SAKHI_PH`) and she turned "Share how I use Sakhi" on (Version 39.60, MODULE_API section 103).
